response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced and versatile software craftsman with strong systems-level background (D language low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, GIS platform development), but he lacks recent, deep C++ or Rust experience and current hands-on work with routing/navigation tile pipelines. His GIS platform and geospatial mapping work (GISCollective, Green Map) is relevant to the domain, but his recent roles (2018-present) are almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js full-stack work, not the systems/routing-tile engineering the role demands.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map) directly relevant to domain
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (Dlang microservices at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Strong generalist engineering background with C/C++ exposure (National Instruments) and comfort learning new stacks
concerns: No recent (last 5+ years) hands-on C++ or Rust production experience; most recent work is TypeScript/Node.js
No explicit experience with routing/navigation tile generation, traffic data integration, or map-data pipelines at production scale
Limited demonstrated exposure to distributed-systems concepts like service discovery/fault tolerance in recent roles

key_factors.factor: Lack of current C++/Rust production work
